uses.sample: Sample docs page: Installing the Tidepool CLI. Requires Node 20 or newer. Install with npm install -g tidepool, then run tidepool login and paste the token from your dashboard. Config lives in tidepool.toml at the project root; the only required field is project. Run tidepool deploy to publish; add --dry-run to see what would change. On Windows use PowerShell 7; WSL is supported, cmd.exe is not. To uninstall, run npm uninstall -g tidepool and delete ~/.tidepool.
